votes.motion: Approve the retreat minutes of January 14, 2025
votes.description: The Council approved the minutes from the City Council retreat held on January 14, 2025.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 06 of 2025 recognizing March 31, 2025, as International Transgender Day of Visibility in Salt Lake City
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall designating March 31, 2025 as International Transgender Day of Visibility in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 15 of 2025 amending the Fiscal Year 2025 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing document, Item E-1: Lead Hazard Reduction Grant ($3,998,800.21 – one-time Miscellaneous Grant Fund)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing and adopted Budget Amendment No. 4 for FY2024-25, which includes a grant to mitigate lead paint hazards funded through a one-time miscellaneous grant.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Item B-2 (Coalition for Green Capital – Municipal Investment Fund grant application) to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the Sustainability Department's grant application to ICLEI for the Coalition for Green Capital Municipal Investment Fund and referred it to a future Consent Agenda for formal action.

The Council approved all items on the Consent Agenda, including setting public hearing dates for four land use matters and approving three Arts Council board appointments (Ignacio Rosenberg, Eugenie Jaffe, and Ryan Canter).
